fusions.name: Stripping Cloud
fusions.desc: Looses 5 darts in a wide spread, each dealing 4 damage. 15% of the damage comes back as healing over 6 seconds, and your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Picked to the Stalk
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 15 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, adding 60% more damage for each one, and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Loosed Swarm
fusions.desc: Shakes a swarm loose from the haft. For 12 seconds it bites an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, and each kill it makes restores 4 health to you.

fusions.name: Gorged on the Field
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, 15% of the damage you deal heals you for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
